cards.name: LIT
cards.milestone_benefits: Depends on features selected; optional milestone-cashback feature gives 5% / 2% cashback on chosen retail categories.
cards.lounge_access: Only via paid feature: domestic airport lounge feature at Rs.399 per 90 days (max 2 visits per 90-day period).
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: Only via paid feature: Rs.49 per 90 days buys 1% fuel surcharge waiver on Rs.400-5,000 transactions.
cards.reward_exclusions: Standard AU exclusions: cash, rent, education, government, EMI, fuel, BBPS, quasi-cash.
cards.notes: India's first customisable card, lifetime free. Feature-selection model: on the AU 0101 app you switch benefits on for 90-day blocks and pay per feature, each auto-renews unless disabled. Published feature fees: 5X reward points Rs.199/qtr, 10X reward points Rs.299/qtr (on all online+offline spends), 5%/2% category cashback, airport lounge Rs.399/qtr, fuel surcharge waiver Rs.49/qtr, Amazon Prime Rs.299/qtr, ZEE5 Rs.99/qtr, Rs.200 Amazon voucher for Rs.50. Base earn without features is 1 RP per Rs.100 (~0.25%). 1 RP = Rs.0.25 on AU Rewardz (Rs.0.20 against gift vouchers).

cards.name: Zenith
cards.milestone_benefits: 1,000 bonus RP on retail spends of Rs.50,000+ in a statement cycle; 2,500 RP birthday bonus on one retail transaction.
cards.lounge_access: 8 domestic lounge visits/year (2 per quarter, needs Rs.50,000 spend in preceding quarter) + 8 international visits/year via Priority Pass.
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% waiver, up to Rs.1,000 per statement cycle.
cards.reward_exclusions: Cash, rent, education, government, EMI, fuel, BBPS, quasi-cash; utility/telecom capped at 100 RP per transaction.
cards.notes: Heavily devalued 1 Jan 2026: base cut 5->3 RP, dining 20->5 RP, international/grocery 10->5 RP; quarterly Rs.1,000 voucher and Taj Epicure milestone removed. Dining bonus capped 5,000 RP/cycle. 1 RP = Rs.0.25 on AU Rewardz. First-year fee waived on Rs.1.25L retail spends within 90 days. Largely superseded by Zenith+.

cards.name: Zenith+
cards.welcome_benefit: Brand voucher worth Rs.5,000 or 5,000 RP (choose one).
cards.milestone_benefits: 1,000 RP on retail spends of Rs.75,000+ per statement cycle; complimentary Taj Epicure membership at Rs.12 lakh annual spends.
cards.lounge_access: 16 domestic lounge visits/year (4 per quarter) + 16 international visits/year via Priority Pass.
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% waiver on Rs.400-5,000 transactions, up to Rs.1,000.
cards.reward_exclusions: Utility, insurance, education, government and rent capped at 1,000 RP total; standard AU exclusions apply to fuel, cash, EMI, BBPS.
cards.eligibility: Monthly net income Rs.2.5 lakh; salaried 21-60, self-employed 25-65.
cards.notes: Metal card. Bank states 1 RP = Rs.1 for this card (unlike Rs.0.25 on most AU cards), so ~1% base / 2% on travel-dining-international. Key draw is 0.99% forex markup.

cards.name: Altura
cards.milestone_benefits: Extra Rs.50 cashback on Rs.10,000+ retail spends per statement cycle.
cards.lounge_access: 8 complimentary railway lounge visits/year (2 per quarter). No airport lounge.
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% waiver on Rs.400-5,000 transactions, up to Rs.100 per cycle.
cards.reward_exclusions: Fuel, rent, wallet loads, cash, education, government, BBPS.
cards.notes: 2% cashback on grocery/departmental/utility and 1% on other retail, each capped at Rs.50 per statement cycle (so max ~Rs.150/month including milestone). First-year fee waived on Rs.10,000 spends within 90 days. Modelled as points with 1 point = Re.1 (cashback).

cards.name: Altura Plus
cards.milestone_benefits: 500 bonus reward points on retail spends of Rs.20,000+ in a calendar month.
cards.lounge_access: 8 complimentary railway lounge visits/year. No airport lounge.
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% waiver on Rs.400-5,000 transactions, up to Rs.150.
cards.reward_exclusions: Fuel, rent, wallet, cash, education, government, BBPS; utility/telecom/insurance earn only 1 RP per Rs.100.
cards.notes: Hybrid earn: 1.5% cashback on OFFLINE retail (capped Rs.100/cycle, modelled here as base) while ONLINE spends earn 2X reward points (2 RP per Rs.100 at Rs.0.25/RP ~ 0.5%). First-year fee waived on Rs.20,000 spends within 90 days.

cards.name: Vetta
cards.milestone_benefits: Quarterly: 500 RP at Rs.50,000 spends + 1,000 more at Rs.1 lakh. Yearly: Rs.1,000 brand vouchers at Rs.2.5 lakh spends.
cards.lounge_access: 1 domestic lounge visit per quarter (Rs.50,000 min quarterly spend from 10 Apr 2026) + 4 international visits/year via Priority Pass.
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% waiver on Rs.400-5,000 transactions, up to Rs.250 per cycle.
cards.reward_exclusions: Cash, rent, education, government, EMI, fuel, BBPS, transportation, quasi-cash; insurance/utility/telecom earn 1 RP per Rs.100 capped 100 RP/txn.
cards.notes: 1 RP = Rs.0.25 on AU Rewardz, so ~0.5% base / 1% grocery. First-year fee waived on Rs.40,000 retail spends within 90 days.

cards.name: NOMO
cards.welcome_benefit: 500 RP on first transaction within 30 days of card setup.
cards.milestone_benefits: 500 RP on Rs.25,000 retail spends in a quarter; 1,000 RP at Rs.50,000.
cards.lounge_access: 2 domestic lounge visits per quarter on Rs.50,000 quarterly spends (from 10 Apr 2026) + 2 railway lounge visits per quarter.
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% waiver on Rs.400-5,000 transactions, up to Rs.100.
cards.reward_exclusions: Utility & insurance earn only 1 RP per Rs.100; standard AU exclusions (cash, rent, fuel, EMI, BBPS, education, government).
cards.eligibility: Age 18-99, Resident Indian, requires individual AU Bank Fixed Deposit (min Rs.20,000, cumulative/auto-renew, sole ownership; joint/tax-saver/non-callable FDs ineligible).
cards.notes: Secured FD-backed card; no income proof/credit history needed. Rs.199 one-time joining fee, free from year 2. Total RP capped at 5,000 per statement cycle. 1 RP = Rs.0.25.

cards.name: Xcite
cards.welcome_benefit: 2X reward points on retail spends made between the 1st and 5th of every month.
cards.lounge_access: 8 complimentary railway lounge visits/year (2 per quarter). No airport lounge.
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% waiver on Rs.400-5,000 transactions, up to Rs.150 per cycle.
cards.reward_exclusions: Cash, rent, education, government, EMI, fuel, BBPS, quasi-cash; insurance/utility/telecom earn 1 RP per Rs.100 capped 100 RP/txn.
cards.notes: Part of AU's SwipeUp upgrade program (pitched to other banks' cardholders). 1 RP = Rs.0.25, so ~0.75% base / 3.75% on dining-movies-grocery. Reward redemption fee Rs.99+GST. Undisclosed caps on accelerated categories may apply.

cards.name: Xcite Ace
cards.lounge_access: 2 domestic lounge visits per quarter (Rs.50,000 spend in previous quarter) + 8 railway lounge visits/year.
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% waiver on Rs.400-5,000 transactions, up to Rs.200.
cards.reward_exclusions: Wallet loads, cash, rent, education, government, EMI, fuel, BBPS, quasi-cash.
cards.notes: Tiered cashback by MONTHLY spend: 1% at Rs.7,500+, 2% at Rs.12,500+, 3% at Rs.20,000+ (modelled at top tier here); max Rs.600 cashback per statement cycle. SwipeUp program card. Insurance: air accident Rs.50L, credit shield Rs.2L, purchase protection Rs.25,000.

cards.name: Xcite Ultra
cards.milestone_benefits: 500 RP on Rs.5,000+ retail spends between the 1st-5th of each month; 5,000 RP on Rs.2.5 lakh annual spends.
cards.lounge_access: 2 domestic lounge visits per quarter (Rs.50,000 spend in previous quarter, from 10 Apr 2026) + 8 railway lounge visits/year.
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% waiver on Rs.400-5,000 transactions, up to Rs.200.
cards.reward_exclusions: Cash, rent, education, government, EMI, fuel, BBPS, quasi-cash; transportation MCCs excluded from 10 Apr 2026; utility/telecom/insurance 1 RP per Rs.100 capped 100 RP/txn.
cards.notes: SwipeUp program card. 1 RP = Rs.0.25: effectively ~1% offline, 2% online, 3% international (before 3.49% forex markup, which negates the international bonus).

cards.name: ixigo AU
cards.welcome_benefit: 1,000 RP + 1,000 ixigo Money on first transaction within 30 days.
cards.milestone_benefits: 5,000 bonus RP on Rs.75,000+ spends per calendar quarter.
cards.lounge_access: Per calendar year: 8 domestic airport (needs Rs.50,000 spend per quarter from Apr 2026), 8 railway, 1 international lounge visit.
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% waiver on Rs.400-5,000 transactions, up to Rs.250.
cards.reward_exclusions: Fuel, rent, insurance, wallets, education, government, BBPS; international transactions earn no RP from Apr 2026 (0% markup still applies).
cards.notes: Lifetime free (limited-period offer; earlier lists show Rs.999). Devalued 13 Apr 2026: flat 5 RP per Rs.200 on all spends (was 10/Rs.200 online). Points worth ~Rs.0.50 when redeemed for flights/hotels on ixigo (~1.25% effective; bank markets it as '2.5% rewards'). Cap 10,000 RP/cycle; redemption fee Rs.99+GST, min 200 RP; points valid 2 years. Also: 10% instant discount up to Rs.3,000/month each on ixigo flights and hotels; train PG-charge waivers 2x/month. UPI-enabled RuPay.

cards.name: Business Cashback
cards.lounge_access: 8 complimentary railway lounge visits/year (2 per quarter).
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% waiver on Rs.400-5,000 transactions, up to Rs.200.
cards.reward_exclusions: Wallet reloads, tax payments, rent, insurance, fuel, cash excluded from cashback.
cards.notes: Fee is Rs.99 PER MONTH (Rs.1,188/yr modelled), waived in any month with Rs.10,000 retail spends in that statement cycle. 1% cashback is credited ON REPAYMENTS and only if the full total amount due is paid; capped Rs.1,000 per statement cycle. Business insurance cover up to Rs.2 lakh; instant business loan facility.

cards.name: Ananta
cards.welcome_benefit: 8,000 bonus RP on card activation / first transaction within 30 days.
cards.milestone_benefits: Up to 50,000 RP per anniversary year: 5,000/10,000/15,000/20,000 RP at Rs.2.5L/5L/7.5L/10L cumulative spends.
cards.lounge_access: 4 domestic lounge visits per quarter, unlocked by flight bookings of Rs.5,000+.
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% waiver on Rs.400-5,000 transactions, up to Rs.200 per cycle.
cards.reward_exclusions: Insurance/utility/telecom earn 1 RP per Rs.100; standard AU exclusions (cash, rent, education, government, EMI, fuel, BBPS).
cards.notes: Part of AU's Nov 2025 portfolio refresh (Ananta/Laksya/Tejas/Prathama). Accelerated 5 RP capped 5,000 RP/cycle. RP value assumed standard AU Rewardz Rs.0.25 (bank markets milestone-inclusive rates higher).

cards.name: Laksya
cards.welcome_benefit: 4,000 bonus RP or Rs.1,000 brand voucher on activation within 30 days.
cards.lounge_access: 8 domestic lounge visits/year (2 per quarter, needs Rs.50,000 quarterly spends).
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% waiver on Rs.400-5,000 transactions, up to Rs.150 per cycle.
cards.reward_exclusions: Insurance/utility/telecom earn 1 RP per Rs.100 capped 100 RP/txn; standard AU exclusions.
cards.notes: Nov 2025 lineup mid-tier card. Accelerated 5 RP capped 1,000 RP/cycle. Up to 15% instant discounts on Amazon Fresh, Zomato and District (movies), capped Rs.250 each per month. Joining fee has no waiver. Bank also spells it 'Lakshya' in some material.

cards.name: Tejas
cards.welcome_benefit: 2,000 bonus RP or Rs.500 brand voucher on activation within 30 days.
cards.milestone_benefits: 500 bonus RP for completing 5 transactions of Rs.500+ per statement cycle.
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% waiver on Rs.400-5,000 transactions, up to Rs.100 per cycle.
cards.reward_exclusions: Cash, rent, education, government, EMI, fuel, BBPS, transportation, quasi-cash.
cards.notes: Nov 2025 lineup 'instant benefits' card: 10% instant discount on movies, grocery, food delivery, cabs and bill payments but each capped at just Rs.50 per category per month. Point earn is weak (1 RP/Rs.100 ~ 0.25%); value is in the merchant discounts.

cards.name: Prathama
cards.milestone_benefits: 2 RP per Rs.100 on incremental spends above Rs.5,000 in a month; 500 bonus RP per standing-instruction setup (once per merchant).
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% waiver on Rs.400-5,000 transactions, up to Rs.100 per cycle.
cards.reward_exclusions: Cash, rent, education, government, EMI, fuel, BBPS, transportation, quasi-cash; utility/telecom capped 100 RP/txn.
cards.notes: Nov 2025 lineup entry card. Low earn (~0.25-0.5%); positioned as a first credit card.

cards.name: SPONT
cards.welcome_benefit: 500 bonus coins on first UPI transaction.
cards.lounge_access: 2 railway lounge visits per quarter + 2 domestic airport lounge visits per quarter (needs Rs.50,000 spend in previous quarter).
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% waiver on Rs.400-5,000 transactions, up to Rs.100 per cycle.
cards.reward_exclusions: Fuel, rent, government, education, cash withdrawals, EMI, insurance.
cards.notes: UPI-first RuPay card: 1% cashback on all eligible transactions (e-comm, POS, contactless, UPI) capped Rs.500 per statement cycle, plus 5 AU Coins per UPI transaction via AU 0101 app (coin value modest, redeemable in-app). Fee-waiver condition not published.

cards.name: Kosmo
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% waiver on Rs.400-5,000 transactions, up to Rs.100 per cycle.
cards.reward_exclusions: Cash, rent, education, government, insurance, EMI, fuel, BBPS.
cards.notes: Lifetime-free UPI RuPay card issued with the Kiwi app; earns 'Kiwi rewards' on UPI scan-and-pay, e-comm, POS and contactless, but AU does not publish the earn rate on its page - verify in the Kiwi app before relying on rates.

cards.name: InstaPay
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% waiver on Rs.400-5,000 fuel transactions.
cards.reward_exclusions: Cashback only on select categories (departmental/grocery/supermarket, restaurants, pharmacy) on transactions of Rs.200+; everything else earns nothing.
cards.eligibility: Only existing AU Bank credit cardholders.
cards.notes: Virtual-only lifetime-free RuPay UPI card (no physical card). 1% cashback on eligible categories capped Rs.100 per statement cycle. 50-day interest-free window.

cards.name: CheQ AU

merchant_bonuses.merchant: Top brands via CheQ (Amazon, Flipkart, Zomato, BigBasket, Apple, CheQ Travel, bills)
10,000+ partner brands via CheQ (online shopping, travel, food, grocery)

cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% waiver, up to Rs.150.
cards.reward_exclusions: Standard AU exclusions (fuel, rent, cash, EMI, government, education).
cards.notes: Co-brand with CheQ (launched 2026); India's first LED credit card - LED variant has Rs.1,499 joining fee (standard Rs.499). Earns per Rs.200: 24 pts top brands (12%), 10 pts partner brands (5%), 5 pts CheQ UPI (2.5%), 2 pts elsewhere (1%); modelled per Rs.100 with 1 point = Re.1 as marketed. Accelerated points capped 12,000/month; base uncapped; points valid 2 years. Accelerated rates require transacting via the CheQ app.

cards.name: Paytm AU
cards.lounge_access: 12 domestic airport lounge visits/year, unlocked via Paytm travel bookings of Rs.5,000+.
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% waiver on Rs.400-5,000 transactions, up to Rs.250 per cycle.
cards.reward_exclusions: Standard AU exclusions; Paytm UPI bonus drops to 1 RP per Rs.100 above Rs.2,000 per transaction.
cards.notes: Lifetime free co-brand. 1 RP = Rs.1 when redeemed as Paytm Gold (best value; other redemptions may value lower). Visa variant adds MakeMyTrip vouchers and Times Prime membership.

cards.name: CA Metal
cards.welcome_benefit: 2,000 bonus RP on Rs.5,000 spends within 30 days; SwiggyOne quarterly dining membership on Rs.10,000 spends within 30 days.
cards.milestone_benefits: Flat 25% cashback on annual ICAI membership fee renewal.
cards.lounge_access: 2 domestic airport lounge visits per quarter.
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% waiver on Rs.400-5,000 transactions, up to Rs.250.
cards.reward_exclusions: Utility/telecom/insurance earn 1 RP per Rs.100; standard AU exclusions.
cards.eligibility: ICAI-registered Chartered Accountants only; salaried 21-60, self-employed 25-65, Resident Indian.
cards.notes: Lifetime-free metal card for CAs. Notable: earns 8 RP per Rs.100 on tax payments (rare). Accelerated categories capped 5,000 RP/cycle. 1 RP = Rs.0.25 (so ~2% on accelerated).

cards.name: CS
cards.welcome_benefit: 2,000 bonus RP on Rs.5,000 spends within 30 days; SwiggyOne quarterly dining membership on Rs.10,000 spends within 30 days.
cards.milestone_benefits: 25% cashback on annual ICSI membership fee renewal.
cards.lounge_access: 2 domestic airport lounge visits per quarter.
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% waiver on Rs.400-5,000 transactions, up to Rs.250.
cards.reward_exclusions: Utility/telecom/insurance earn 1 RP per Rs.100; standard AU exclusions.
cards.eligibility: ICSI-registered Company Secretaries only; salaried 21-60, self-employed 25-65, Resident Indian.
cards.notes: Lifetime-free card for Company Secretaries; mirrors the CA Metal card's structure. Accelerated categories capped 5,000 RP/cycle. 1 RP = Rs.0.25.

cards.name: Traverse
cards.welcome_benefit: MakeMyTrip voucher worth Rs.5,000 on activation within 30 days.
cards.milestone_benefits: Taj voucher worth Rs.10,000 on Rs.10 lakh annual spends (fuel and cash excluded from milestone counting).
cards.lounge_access: 2 domestic + 2 international airport lounge visits per quarter.
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% waiver on Rs.400-5,000 transactions, up to Rs.250.
cards.reward_exclusions: Insurance/utility/telecom earn 1 RP per Rs.100 capped 100 RP/txn; fuel, EMI, cash, rent excluded.
cards.eligibility: Non-Resident Indians only, age 18-75, with AU NRE account and NRE Fixed Deposit.
cards.notes: NRI-only card secured against NRE FD. RP value assumed standard AU Rewardz Rs.0.25 (not stated on product page).
